objective: Convert the existing precommit_telegraph contract into one executable, authority-free FIELD/INTERPHASE forecast without creating another route, queue, planner or game layer.
delta: interphase-action-forecast/v0.1 is derived only from the move's declared authority, target, dispatch and reversibility metadata.
VIEW → READ_ONLY / NO_COMMIT; NAVIGATION → NAVIGATION_ONLY / NAVIGATION; OFFER → OFFER_ONLY / RECEIVER_ACCEPTS; EDIT/EFFECT remain HOST_NATIVE with host-defined mutation/reversal.
FIELD renders the forecast inside the existing NEXT cell and changes the reading on hover/focus/touch without activating the move.
FIELD 0.8.27 point-of-action UNDO SEEN remains intact.

authority.native_host: actual commit, effect, reversal and domain truth

nonclaims: No prediction of undeclared domain outcomes.
No automatic action, permission or priority.
No guarantee of reversibility when the host declares HOST_DEFINED.

proof.browser: tools/browser-smoke.mjs · FIELD held INTERPHASE carrier in-place

retirement: If native owners expose the same precommit forecast directly through the shared action surface, retire FIELD-specific forecast chrome and retain only the common carrier contract.
